blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — House prosecutor Rep. Leila de Lima is expected to represent the prosecution panel during Wednesday’s oral arguments on how to interpret the two-thirds threshold required by the Constitution to convict an impeached official. “I understand that it will be Congresswoman Leila de Lima,” House prosecutor Rep. Chel Diokno said in an interview
